why: This is a named, study-specific chemistry achievement assessment instrument rather than a reusable instructional element; it should be catalogued as an assessment product.
name: 25-item Chemistry Achievement Test (CAT) on stoichiometry and mole concept
product_description: A 25-item researcher-developed chemistry achievement test measuring Senior Secondary 2 students' understanding of stoichiometry and the mole concept, used as a pre-test and post-test in the study.
